# vyos.blueprints.vrf_lite

Inter-VRF routing over VRF Lite (docs blueprint of the same name)

- Creates VRFs with their tables, member interfaces and static routes, and leaks routes between them with MP-BGP inside one router - per VRF a route distinguisher, export/import route targets, `export vpn` / `import vpn`, redistribution and an optional VPN import route-map. eBGP neighbours can run inside a VRF (e.g. the Internet VRF).
- VRF tables, static routes and VRF BGP neighbours use vyos.vyos.vyos_vrf; plain ethernet VRF membership vyos_interfaces; the global AS vyos_bgp_global. The VRF BGP address families (RD, RT, import/export vpn, redistribute, route-map vpn import), VRF membership of other interface types and neighbour address-family activation use vyos.vyos.vyos_config, because vyos_vrf cannot express them yet.
- vyos_vrf also sets `vrf name <VRF> protocols bgp system-as` (same AS) for VRFs with neighbours, and renders `delete vrf bind-to-all` unless `vrf_lite_bind_to_all` is true.
- Also used for the PE VRFs of MPLS L3VPN (with `label_vpn_export`), see `vyos.blueprints.l3vpn`.
- Interface addressing belongs to `vyos.blueprints.base`; route-maps for import filtering to `vyos.blueprints.route_policy`.

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.vrf_lite
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vrf_lite_asn` | int |  |  | Global BGP AS (`protocols bgp system-as`). Nothing is configured when unset. |
| `vrf_lite_bind_to_all` | bool |  | `false` | Set `vrf bind-to-all`. |
| `vrf_lite_vrfs` | list |  | `[]` | VRFs. |
| `vrf_lite_vrfs.name` | str | yes |  | VRF name, e.g. `LAN1`. |
| `vrf_lite_vrfs.table` | int | yes |  | Routing table id. |
| `vrf_lite_vrfs.description` | str |  |  | VRF description. |
| `vrf_lite_vrfs.interfaces` | list |  | `[]` | Member interfaces. |
| `vrf_lite_vrfs.routes` | list |  | `[]` | Static routes in the VRF; IPv6 when `dest` contains `:`. |
| `vrf_lite_vrfs.routes.dest` | str | yes |  | Destination prefix. |
| `vrf_lite_vrfs.routes.next_hop` | str | yes |  | Next-hop address. |
| `vrf_lite_vrfs.rd` | str |  |  | Route distinguisher, e.g. `64496:1`. |
| `vrf_lite_vrfs.route_targets_export` | list |  | `[]` | Export route targets. |
| `vrf_lite_vrfs.route_targets_import` | list |  | `[]` | Import route targets (routes from VRFs exporting these). |
| `vrf_lite_vrfs.families` | list |  | `[ipv4, ipv6]` | Address families to leak. |
| `vrf_lite_vrfs.redistribute` | list |  | `[]` | Route types redistributed into the VRF's BGP, e.g. `[static]`. |
| `vrf_lite_vrfs.networks` | list |  | `[]` | Prefixes announced from the VRF (`network`); IPv6 when they contain `:`. |
| `vrf_lite_vrfs.label_vpn_export` | str |  |  | VPN label allocation, e.g. `auto` for MPLS L3VPN. |
| `vrf_lite_vrfs.import_route_map` | dict |  | `{}` | Route-map filtering imported VPN routes, per family, e.g. `{ipv4: LAN2-Internet, ipv6: LAN2-Internet-v6}`. |
| `vrf_lite_vrfs.neighbors` | list |  | `[]` | eBGP neighbours inside this VRF; the address family follows the address. |
| `vrf_lite_vrfs.neighbors.address` | str | yes |  | Neighbour address. |
| `vrf_lite_vrfs.neighbors.remote_as` | int | yes |  | Neighbour AS. |
| `vrf_lite_vrfs.neighbors.as_override` | bool |  | `false` | Replace the neighbour's AS in the AS path with ours (sites sharing one AS). |
| `vyos_blueprints_render_only` | bool |  | `false` | Collect commands into `vyos_blueprints_rendered` instead of configuring. |

## Entry point `verify` (`tasks_from: verify`)

Run with `tasks_from=verify`. Checks every VRF exists and every VRF BGP session is established.

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vrf_lite_vrfs` | list |  | `[]` | Same value as for `main`. |
